description: Java class 'SimpleGeofenceStore' manages storage and retrieval of geofence data using Android SharedPreferences, including methods to get, set, and clear geofence entries.

classes.name: SimpleGeofenceStore
classes.description: Class providing storage management for geofence data using SharedPreferences.

methods.name: SimpleGeofenceStore
methods.description: Constructor initializing SharedPreferences storage with application context.

methods.name: getGeofence
methods.description: Retrieves a stored geofence by its ID, returning null if not found or invalid.

methods.name: setGeofence
methods.description: Saves a SimpleGeofence object into SharedPreferences under a specified ID.

methods.name: clearGeofence
methods.description: Removes all stored data related to a specific geofence ID.

methods.name: getGeofenceFieldKey
methods.description: Generates a key string for a geofence field in SharedPreferences based on ID and field name.
